env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/bin/nocheck$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/nocheck$GOEXE
stdout '^nil-ok: -1$'
! stderr 'logos:'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/nc

go 1.27

-- w/l/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Deref(p *int) int {
	if p == nil {
		return -1
	}
	return *p
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/ncg

go 1.27

require example.com/nc v0.0.0

replace example.com/nc => ../l

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/nc/lib"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("nil-ok:", lib.Deref(nil))
}
